dedupe_keys.name: large eddy simulation of dam break driven swash on a rough planar beach

description: Large eddy simulation of dam-break-driven swash on a rough-planar beach is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Tian-Jian Hsu, University of Delaware (udel.edu). Turbulence characteristics in the swash zone are investigated using a 3-D large eddy simulation model. The numerical simulation was carried out using OpenFOAM which solves the filtered Navier-Stokes equations for two immiscible fluids (air and water) with a standard Smagorinsky subgrid-scale closure. This work is published in Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans (2017), doi:10.1002/2016JC012366. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2XM4N. Keywords: Large eddy simulation, dam-break, swash, finger patterns, OpenFOAM, InterFoam. Published 2018-05-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
